speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: I understand that drugs included on the Cancer Drug List (CDL) are based on cost effectiveness thresholds.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Can the Ministry clarify how these thresholds are set and how often are they reviewed?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Those from the lower-income groups would already get a higher means-tested subsidy.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, we already are seeing very good results.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: It means that there is more accessibility to these drugs.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: There is nothing stopping the higher-income individuals from loading themselves with expensive insurance that actually covers all drugs.
